courses.summary: 哈西梅薩烏德的原始技術研究討論油藏與氣體注入；本課以公開背景建立體積與物料帳。本課依序分析地質分區不確定度、地面油氣分離、沙漠處理廠熱負荷、不同量測基準對照、長距備件支援，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Primary technical work on Hassi Messaoud discusses reservoir development and gas injection; this course builds volume and material accounts from that background. The course analyses geological-compartment uncertainty, surface oil-gas separation, desert processing heat duty, comparing measurement bases, long-distance spare support, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
